text: I almost didn't call you, because Dr. Merrick referred me to you.
He was my doctor at the hospital.
Would you like to talk about your hospitalization, about Dr. Merrick?
I'm not going to ask you anything specific about your hospitalization,
but could you tell me if perhaps there was one single inciting incident that led up to it?
And I just, one minute I knew who I was, and then the next minute I had no idea.
It's hard to explain, but my identity just came apart like old rotten lace.
